Get Project Details for Billing

Source: R/get_project_details_for_billing.R
get_project_details_for_billing.Rd

This function retrieves detailed information about specific projects for billing purposes. It queries:

  • redcap_projects

  • redcap_entity_project_ownership

  • redcap_user_information

  • invoice_line_item

Usage

get_project_details_for_billing(rc_conn, rcc_billing_conn, project_ids)

Arguments

rc_conn

A REDCap database connection, e.g. the object returned from connect_to_redcap_db

rcc_billing_conn

A connection to REDCap billing database. connect_to_rcc_billing_db

project_ids

Vector of project IDs to retrieve details for.

Value

A data frame with project details.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
rc_conn <- connect_to_redcap_db()
rcc_billing_conn <- connect_to_rcc_billing_db()
project_ids <- c(12, 14, 22)
project_details <- get_project_details_for_billing(rc_conn, rcc_billing_con, project_ids)
} # }
